Diagnose configuration and print an MCP config snippet

Usage: kprun doctor [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]...

Arguments:
  [COMMAND]...  MCP server command to append after `run <entry> --` (place after `--` on the CLI)

Options:
      --mcp <MCP>  Print an MCP config JSON snippet for this vault entry instead of diagnostics
  -h, --help       Print help
